keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: One per line. Compare up to 5 terms on one line with "vs": chatgpt vs gemini vs claude. Each line returns interest over time, interest by region and related queries. Also accepts "searchTerms" and "keyword".

geo.title: Country or region
geo.description: Two-letter country code (US, GB, DE) or region code (US-CA). Empty for worldwide.

timeRange.title: Time range
timeRange.description: Past hour to 2004-present. Shorter ranges give hourly or daily points, longer ones weekly or monthly.

category.title: Category id
category.description: Google Trends category id, e.g. 71 Food & Drink, 5 Computers & Electronics. 0 is all categories.

property.title: Search type
property.description: Which Google search the interest is measured on.

includeRegions.title: Interest by region
includeRegions.description: Countries worldwide, or states and regions within a country.

includeRelatedQueries.title: Related queries
includeRelatedQueries.description: Top and rising related searches for each term.

trendingNowGeos.title: Trending now: countries
trendingNowGeos.description: Country codes (US, GB, IN...). Returns what is trending in Google Search there right now, with approximate traffic and linked news. Works with or without keywords.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language for query and region names, e.g. en-US, de, fr.

maxItems.title: Max results
maxItems.description: Stop after this many charged rows. 0 means no limit.

minDelaySecs.title: Minimum delay between requests (seconds)
minDelaySecs.description: Google Trends limits requests per IP. The Actor waits at least this long between requests and slows down by itself when Google pushes back.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Not needed. Your own proxies can make very large runs faster, since Google's limit is per IP.
